name: obs-studio-bridge
description: Secure, allowlisted OBS Studio controls over the Model Context Protocol.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control OBS Studio safely.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to OBS Studio through a localhost-only, bearer-authenticated MCP bridge with a fixed allowlist of inspection and control actions.
defaultPrompt: Check OBS status and diagnose performance.
List my OBS scenes and visible sources.
Show my audio inputs and mute states.
